items.title: Lottery #7718 · Brooklyn · 217 units · deadline 2026-11-25
items.en_title: Brooklyn mega lottery: 217 affordable rentals, closing Nov 25
items.en_oneliner: The biggest opening on the board: 217 Brooklyn rentals, closing Nov 25, with homes for extremely low, very low and low incomes and every bedroom size; if you can only apply to one lottery, make it this one.
items.source: NYC Open Data: Housing Connect Lotteries
